name: copy_word_pair_twice
description: Copies two 16-bit fields from one pair of offsets in a structure addressed by the A4 register to another pair of offsets, advances the pointer by two bytes and repeats the copy once more.

name: double_global_pair
description: Performs a self-addition of a pair of global longwords with carry passed between the halves, writes the new values back into the pair and copies the result into a third global.

name: store_constant_global_pair
description: Stores two fixed 32-bit constants into a pair of global variables and returns.

name: decrement_word_and_reset_sprites
description: Decrements a word and subtracts a register value from a long through two pointers, then writes a fixed value to the sprite pointer registers and to memory location zero, writes an interrupt-disable mask to the interrupt enable register and sets a global variable to that mask.

name: reset_sprites_disable_interrupts
description: Writes a fixed value to the sprite pointer registers and to memory location zero, writes an interrupt-disable mask to the interrupt enable register, and sets a global variable to the same mask before returning.

name: increment_counter_and_branch
description: Adds four to a global counter and XORs a second global with a constant. If bit five of a flag global is set, it increments the flag three times, clears it, calls another routine twice and then sets the flag to a fixed value.

name: poll_input_ports
description: Calls another routine twice to read input values and merges each result into the upper bits of a global flag byte, keeping bits four to six and storing the merged value.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately; the decompiled body contains only a return, so the routine touches no memory, registers or other routines.

name: run_subtasks_loop
description: Calls one routine, then repeats a loop thirteen times, calling five other routines on each pass.

name: run_routine_sequence_with_loop
description: Calls one routine eight times in a row, then, unless a global variable equals a particular character or has its top bit set, calls other routines and runs a loop seventeen times with four other routine calls per pass.

name: run_conditional_routine_loop
description: When a global variable is neither a particular character nor has its top bit set, calls two other routines and one more other routine, then runs a loop seventeen times with four other routine calls per pass.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns.

name: poll_global_flag_until_ready
description: Loops until a global flag byte meets one of several bit and value conditions and then returns; if the byte is zero, it stores a fixed value into it before returning.

name: process_input_buffer
description: Stores a fixed value in a global flag and scans a zero-terminated byte buffer. Bytes below a threshold cause the next byte to be skipped; other bytes trigger a sequence of other routine calls, including one call with a word argument when a flag bit is set.

name: call_through_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is held in a pointer register, then returns.

name: merge_word_blocks_masked
description: Runs sixteen times, building a mask from several source words, then for each of five destination words ORs the matching source word into the destination word after clearing the bits the mask excludes, advancing both pointers each pass.

name: copy_words_to_scattered_offsets
description: Runs sixteen times, copying five consecutive source words into five destination words at fixed spacing from a base derived from an argument, advancing the source and destination pointers each pass.

name: copy_words_from_scattered_offsets
description: Runs sixteen times, copying five words from scattered offsets in a base area derived from an argument into five consecutive source words, advancing both pointers by fixed steps each pass.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:0:0000
name: run_program_startup_calls
description: Program entry point. It calls other routines and a routine held in a register, makes an indirect call through the system library base three times, clears a stored word and returns.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:0:003C
name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Repeatedly decrements a data register, starting from its existing value, until it reaches negative one, then returns.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:3:0000
name: run_two_pass_accumulate_loop
description: Calls an indirect routine twice, then runs two passes. Each pass calls other routines, reads bits from another routine result and, under conditions, repeatedly adds a value into memory at a computed offset.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:3:005A
name: stub_zero_result_return
description: Merges zero into a result register and returns. The decompiled body is much longer than the two instructions in the listing, so the decompilation for this routine is not reliable.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:3:0060
name: copy_bytes_backward_bit_driven
description: Copies bytes from an input pointer that moves backward into an output pointer, using a bit buffer kept in globals to decide how many bytes each copy covers and calling other routines to fetch the next bits or count.

key: indiana jones and the fate of atlantis - arcade (1992)(lucasarts)[cr csl][v systemz v4.0]/Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis - Arcade (1992)(LucasArts)[cr CSL][v SystemZ v4.0].adf:Indy IV/Indy-IV:3:01D6
name: copy_reversed_byte_quads
description: Copies groups of four bytes from a source pointer that moves backward into an output pointer that moves forward, refilling a bit buffer from globals and stopping when a counter reaches zero.

name: open_libraries_and_wait_port
description: Calls exec routines to find the current task, open and close libraries and wait on a message port, and writes the DMA control and copper list pointer registers. The decompiler timed out, so the control flow is not shown.

name: release_table_and_loop_forever
description: If a global is set, calls two library routines and stores the result. Otherwise it calls other routines, writes the copper list pointer and DMA control registers, frees each entry of a zero-terminated pointer table through the exec base, calls more other routines and then loops forever.

name: stub_self_assignment_return
description: Assigns a global variable to itself and returns, so it has no effect; the routine is effectively a stub.

name: format_two_digit_decimal_text
description: Writes the tens and units of a value into a fixed text buffer as characters when it differs from another value, then looks up a value in a table to call library routines and returns a status.

name: read_four_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns a four-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: read_five_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns a five-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: read_six_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns a six-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: read_seven_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns a seven-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: read_eight_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns an eight-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: read_nine_bit_field
description: If a global counter is below seven, calls another routine first. It then subtracts a bit count derived from the caller's bit position from the counter and returns a nine-bit field extracted from the word the caller's pointer addresses.

name: copy_buffer_then_read_chunk
description: Copies a block of bytes into a buffer, then reads up to a fixed chunk size through a library call. On failure it writes the two decimal digits of the error code into a text message and calls other routines; with a zero count it runs a sequence of other routine and hardware register calls.

name: close_file_if_open
description: If a stored file handle is not the sentinel value of minus one, closes it through a library call and resets the handle to that sentinel value.

name: delay_and_set_cia_port
description: Waits through three short countdown delays and, between them, writes a masked value to the port B data register of a CIA chip, then returns.

name: allocate_signal_and_init_block
description: Allocates an exec signal bit and, on success, zeroes a block of memory, stores the signal number and the current task pointer into it and links its fields. When allocation fails it calls other routines instead.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Writes a byte value to a run of consecutive memory locations, with the count held in a register.

name: copy_bytes_overlap_safe
description: Copies a run of bytes between two regions. When the destination lies before the source it copies forward, otherwise it copies from the end backward so that overlapping regions are preserved.

name: copy_bytes_backward
description: Copies a counted run of bytes from the end of a source region backward into the end of a destination region, so overlapping regions are handled.

name: dispatch_through_jump_table
description: Calls a routine selected through a jump table, with the entry indexed by a value. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the target routine is not identified.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library and, on success, stores its address and size into a record in a list and advances the list pointer. When allocation fails it calls other routines to handle the error.

name: allocate_memory_or_report_error
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library and records it in a list. When the allocation fails it reports an out-of-memory error through other routines and returns a status.

name: concatenate_strings_into_buffer
description: Copies one zero-terminated string into a fixed buffer and appends a second string after it, then calls other routines. If a global flag is clear it writes copper and DMA registers, frees the entries of a pointer table through the exec base and loops forever.

name: clear_long_table_and_flag
description: Writes zero to thirty-two consecutive longwords at a fixed address and clears a global variable.

name: increment_counter_around_calls
description: Increments a global counter, calls one routine, resets the counter to zero and then calls another routine before returning.

name: track_port_movement_deltas
description: Reads the movement counter registers for the mouse and joystick ports, stores their low and high bytes, and adds each change since the previous reading to a running total for each port, for two entries.

name: copy_globals_then_enable_interrupts
description: Copies global variables around in a shuffle and writes an interrupt enable value that sets the master and external enable bits.

name: read_interrupt_status_registers
description: Reads the interrupt enable and interrupt request registers and calls two other routines. The decompiler timed out, so the exact logic is not shown.

name: access_interrupt_request_register
description: Accesses the interrupt request register and calls one other routine. The decompiler timed out, so the logic is not shown.

name: stub_two_instruction_routine
description: A two-instruction routine that the decompiler did not decode, so only its single call site is known and its behaviour is not shown.

name: decode_serial_input_byte
description: Reads a byte from the serial data register, rotates and inverts it into a code, updates a state table entry for that code, then waits for the serial transfer flag before resetting the control bits.

name: record_key_state_and_char
description: Stores a masked code and the previous table entry, updates the table entry from the top bit of the input byte and, when the entry is set, records the matching character from a text table. It then waits for the serial transfer flag and clears control bits.

name: call_then_enable_interrupts
description: Calls another routine, copies a global value to itself and writes an interrupt enable value that sets the master and external enable bits.

name: disable_external_interrupt_bit
description: Writes an interrupt enable value that clears the external interrupt bit without setting the enable bit, switching that interrupt off.

name: enable_master_external_interrupts
description: Writes an interrupt enable value with the master and external enable bits set to the interrupt enable register.

name: open_resource_and_init_block
description: Initialises fields of a memory block, stores a routine address in it, opens a named system resource through the exec library and, if that succeeds, calls two routines of the resource.

name: call_resource_routines_if_set
description: If a stored resource pointer is set, calls two routines through its function table and returns.

name: call_routines_then_loop_forever
description: Calls other routines and then loops forever. Some code blocks were removed by the decompiler as unreachable.

name: stub_return_only_body
description: Returns immediately. Although the listing has forty instructions, the decompiled body is only a return, so the decompilation may be incomplete.

name: copy_every_other_word_reversed
description: Optionally selects a source pointer from a flag bit, then copies sixteen words in reverse order, taking one word from each pair of words in a source block into a global area.

name: silence_audio_channels
description: Writes the DMA control register with the four audio channel bits cleared, which disables those channels, and zeroes the volume registers of the four audio channels.

name: write_indexed_table_entries
description: Loops over a fixed table of index and value pairs, storing each value as a longword at an address offset by its index, for a count taken from a global variable.

description: Stores a parameter in a task record and calls an optional callback when one is set, then calls two other routines. The library calls it makes unlock, close, free and reply to resources.

name: measure_string_length_calling_routine

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(de)[cr toxic - prelux](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(De)[cr Toxic - Prelux](Disk 1 of 7).adf:KillAGA:0:047C
name: free_linked_list_nodes
description: Frees every node of one linked list through the exec memory-free call and clears its head pointer. It then processes nodes taken from a second list, calling other routines for each.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(de)[cr toxic - prelux](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(De)[cr Toxic - Prelux](Disk 1 of 7).adf:KillAGA:0:0500
name: allocate_record_or_set_error
description: If a record's flag bit is clear, calls another routine to allocate its buffer and stores the result in the record. On failure it stores an error code and returns minus one; on success it clears two flag bits, zeroes two fields and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(de)[cr toxic - prelux](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(De)[cr Toxic - Prelux](Disk 1 of 7).adf:KillAGA:0:0550
name: write_to_dos_handle
description: Checks the flags of a file handle and, when the handle is writable, writes data through the dos library, looping while writes succeed. If the handle is missing or not writable it stores an error code and returns a failure status.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(de)[cr toxic - prelux](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(De)[cr Toxic - Prelux](Disk 1 of 7).adf:KillAGA:0:0642
name: check_handle_and_write
description: Checks the handle returned by another routine: a null handle records an invalid-argument error and returns minus one. Otherwise it calls a dos function, records the library error and returns minus one on failure, or passes on the returned count.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(de)[cr toxic - prelux](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(De)[cr Toxic - Prelux](Disk 1 of 7).adf:KillAGA:0:0652
name: seek_dos_handle_checked
description: Checks that a file handle is set and stores an invalid-argument error if not. Otherwise it seeks the handle, storing the dos error and an I/O error marker when the seek fails, and seeks a second time when the parameter is two.
